capabilities: create and monitor multiple countdown timers in a dedicated sidebar
start reusable timer presets with optional warning times and colors
launch timers from notes via game-timer code blocks
pause, resume, or cancel running timers from a footer
notify via Obsidian notices or desktop notifications when timers finish
extras: Timers persist across Obsidian reloads and can run once or repeat continuously; installation is by manually copying the plugin folder into .obsidian/plugins/.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in countdown timers for tracking time limits during game sessions.
summary: Sidebar plugin for DM-facing countdown timers with presets, code-block launchers, finish notifications, and a running-timer footer.
